queuedIdeas.title: Implement local/global sparse attention ablation
queuedIdeas.hypothesis: A simple local-window attention path with a small number of global summary tokens can reduce attention dependencies while preserving enough long-range mixing for Parameter Golf's short training budget.

cpuPreflight.objective: Prove output shape parity, causal masking, and deterministic dense fallback on tiny CPU smoke.
cpuPreflight.successSignal: CPU smoke passes and dense mode remains bitwise unchanged for the baseline path.

gpuPromotionDraft.oneH100Criteria: At least equal bpb within noise while improving tokens/sec or memory headroom versus dense-control batch-tune.
gpuPromotionDraft.eightH100Criteria: Only promote after 1xH100 has positive throughput signal and no artifact-budget regression.
gpuPromotionDraft.retirementCriteria: Retire if window/global routing loses bpb without measurable throughput gain.

queuedIdeas.title: Implement block-sparse attention scoring rehearsal
queuedIdeas.hypothesis: Block-level importance scoring can skip enough attention blocks to matter only if it is implemented in an IO-aware way; dense mask simulation is useful for correctness but not sufficient for GPU promotion.

cpuPreflight.objective: Compare dense attention to block-selected attention on tiny sequences and record selected-block ratios.
cpuPreflight.successSignal: No causal leakage; selected-block telemetry is emitted; dense fallback remains unchanged.

gpuPromotionDraft.oneH100Criteria: Real H100 timing improves over dense flash policy, not just theoretical FLOP count.
gpuPromotionDraft.eightH100Criteria: Requires 1xH100 speedup plus stable batch auto-tune behavior.
gpuPromotionDraft.retirementCriteria: Retire if scorer overhead erases sparse attention savings.

queuedIdeas.title: Implement content-routed sparse attention cheap screen
queuedIdeas.hypothesis: Content-based routing may find useful long-range dependencies, but it is risky in a 10-minute training contest unless routing overhead is tightly bounded.

cpuPreflight.objective: Design an O(n log n) or bounded-cost routing approximation before any GPU implementation.
cpuPreflight.successSignal: Routing overhead estimate is below dense attention savings on the Parameter Golf sequence length.

gpuPromotionDraft.oneH100Criteria: Only after CPU profiling predicts net savings and implementation exposes routing telemetry.
gpuPromotionDraft.eightH100Criteria: Requires clear 1xH100 bpb or throughput win.
gpuPromotionDraft.retirementCriteria: Retire if routing refresh cost or instability dominates.

queuedIdeas.title: Evaluate inference-only sparse attention for final scoring
queuedIdeas.hypothesis: Inference-only sparse attention may reduce final eval time, but it must preserve exact legality, scoring semantics, and roundtrip artifact reproducibility.

cpuPreflight.objective: Prove deterministic final_int8_zlib_roundtrip evaluation and no validation-data leakage or adaptive cheating.
cpuPreflight.successSignal: Legality note and deterministic CPU smoke exist before GPU run.

gpuPromotionDraft.oneH100Criteria: Final eval time improves with bpb regression below retirement threshold.
gpuPromotionDraft.eightH100Criteria: Only if legality review passes and final score remains reproducible.
gpuPromotionDraft.retirementCriteria: Retire immediately on nondeterminism or legality uncertainty.
